coordinate_system: .text file offset = VA - 0x1000; .data.rel.ro/.got file offset = VA - 0x2000; .rodata file offset = VA

flag_condition.condition: root key count == 0 at loop exit
flag_condition.semantics: flag = 1 exactly when the rebalance cascade reaches a node with no parent whose key count is 0; the completion helper then promotes that root's first child and frees the old root, so the tree height shrinks by one. The flag is NOT set when the removed node is itself the root (single-node tree) or when any ancestor keeps a positive key count.

limitations: Merge helper 0x4ca2500 and redistribute helpers 0x4c93c20 / 0x4c9b3b0 internals are not decoded; only their dispatch threshold, call sites, and argument shapes are pinned.
The loc second field (+0x8, remaining levels below the node, 0 at both call sites) is carried +1 into the sibling frames; its exact downstream use inside the merge core is not fully traced.

The two panic message lengths (123 and, after the wrapper transform, 81) span packed adjacent string literals in .rodata; the packet quotes each message's leading literal and pins its Location, and does not claim the trailing packed bytes are part of one source literal.
The freed node (r12) is identified as the merged-away node by dataflow (current node on a left merge, right sibling on a right merge); the free wrapper 0x635de30 itself is not decoded.
Static analysis only; the node binary was never executed.
loc_layout: [0x8] remaining levels below the node (0 = leaf, at both call sites)

node_layout_328.second_counter_u16: +0xe4 = child index within parent's children array
node_layout_328.value_slots: 16 bytes each at +16*i: [0] u64 value, [8] flag byte

out_layout_48: [0x10] removed value flag byte (saved at entry, [rsp+0x6])

panics.condition: right-sibling path with parent key count == 0 (0x4d248fc je, 0x4d24b3a je)
panics.leading_message: internal error: entered unreachable code: empty internal node

panics.condition: children-memmove length mismatch after a parent-level merge (0x4d24de2 jne)

second_counter_e4.selection_rule: 0 -> right sibling (children[1] at +0xf0); nonzero -> left sibling (children[index-1] at +0xe0 + 8*index)
second_counter_e4.semantics: the node's 0-based index within its parent's children array

thresholds.merge_gate: combined (old current + sibling) < 12, i.e. merged size <= 11 = capacity; sites 0x4d248bb, 0x4d2494e, 0x4d24afe, 0x4d24b92 (upward gates use combined + 1 < 12 with the already-decremented count)
thresholds.underflow_gate: new key count <= 4 triggers rebalance; sites 0x4d2483e (ja exit), 0x4d24a72 (ja exit), 0x4d249f6 (jbe enter loop)
